1. (Currently amended) A method for treating an ocular condition, the method comprising: administering to the interior of an eye a composition comprising a therapeutically effective amount of a macromolecular anti-angiogenic component (MAAC) __comprising a protein__ to a mammal suffering from an ocular condition, wherein the composition also comprises a viscosity inducing component in an amount effective to increase the viscosity of the composition to a viscosity at about 25° C. of __10 cps or more__ at a shear rate of about 0.1/second, wherein said viscosity inducing component is injectable into the vitreous of a mammalian eye without permanently diminishing visual acuity, __and wherein the composition is administered to the interior of said eye by placement into the posterior segment of the eye through a 27-gauge needle__.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim [[12]] __1__ wherein said composition comprises a solution.

3. (Previously presented) The method of claim 1 wherein said composition comprises a gel.

4. (Previously presented) The method of claim 1 wherein said composition comprises a suspension.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein [[a symptom of the ocular condition is angiogenesis]] __the ocular condition is associated with angiogenesis__ and the MAAC comprises a direct or indirect inhibitor of a vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) activity.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim [[5]] __1__ wherein said MAAC comprises [[an agent selected from the group consisting of a nucleic acid (a oligonucleotide) and a polypeptide]] __a protein__.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein said MAAC comprises a protein __selected from the group consisting of an antibody, an antibody mimic, an angiogenesis inhibitor, and a receptor inhibitor__.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 14 wherein said protein is selected from the group consisting of [[an antibody, an antibody mimic,]] an angiogenesis inhibitor[[ and a receptor inhibitor]].

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 14 wherein said protein comprises a therapeutic agent selected form the group consisting of [[ADNECTIN@ CT-322, ADNECTIN® C7S100, ADNECTIN@ C7C 100, rambizumab,]] bevacizumab[[, urokinase peptide inhibitor A6, cisplatin, rapamycin, endostatin, angiostatin, tumstatin, pigment epithelium derived factor, and VEGF TRAP® , IMC-18F 1 and IMC-1121 Fab]].

20. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein said viscosity inducing component comprises [[a compound selected from the group consisting of]] a hyaluronic acid[[, a cross-linked hyaluronic acid, a crosslinked polymer containing subunits derived from acrylic acid, polyacrylic acid, celluloses derivatives, polycarbophil, polyvinylpyrrolidone, gelatin, dextrin, polysaccharides, polyacrylamide, polyvinyl alcohol, polyvinyl acetate, and derivatives, mixtures and copolymers thereof]].

21. (Previously presented) The method of claim 1 wherein said viscosity inducing component comprises a compound having a molecular weight in the range from about 10,000 Daltons to about 2 million Daltons.

22. (Currently amended) The method of claim [[17]] __20__ wherein said viscosity inducing component comprises a compound having a molecular weight in the range of about 100,000 Daltons to about 1.5 million Daltons.

23. (Currently amended) The method of claim [[17]] __20__ wherein said viscosity inducing component comprises a compound having a molecular weight in the range of about 200,000 Daltons to about 1 million Daltons.

24. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein said viscosity inducing component has a viscosity of __100 cps or more__ at a shear rate of 0.1/second at 25° C.

25. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein said viscosity inducing component has a viscosity of __1000 cps or more__ at a shear rate of 0.1/second at 25° C.

26. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein said viscosity inducing component has a viscosity of __10,000 cps or more__ at a shear rate of 0.1/second at 25° C.

27. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein said viscosity inducing component has a viscosity of __70,000 cps or more__ at a shear rate of 0.1/second at 25° C.

28. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein said viscosity inducing component has a viscosity of __200,000 cps or more__ at a shear rate of 0.1/second at 25° C.

29. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein said viscosity inducing component has a viscosity of __250,000 cps or more__ at a shear rate of 0.1/second at 25° C.

30. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein said viscosity inducing component has a viscosity of __300,000 cps or more__ at a shear rate of 0.1/second at 25° C.

31. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein said composition is administered to the interior of said eye by placement into the posterior segment of the eye through a 27-gauge needle.

32. (Previously presented) The method of claim 1 wherein said condition comprises a condition of the posterior segment of the eye.

33. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein said condition is selected from the group consisting of [[macular degeneration, including non- exudative age related macular degeneration and exudative age related macular degeneration, choroidal neovascularization, retinopathy, diabetic retinopathy, acute and chronic macular neuroretinopathy, central serous chorioretinopathy, macular edema, acute multifocal placoid pigment epitheliopathy, Behcet's disease, birdshot retinochoroidopathy, posterior scleritis, serpignous choroiditis, subretinal fibrosis, uveitis syndrome, Vogt-Koyanagi-Harada syndrome, retinal arterial occlusive disease, central retinal vein occlusion, disseminated intravascular coagulopathy, branch retinal vein occlusion, hypertensive fundus changes, ocular ischemic syndrome, retinal arterial microaneurysms, Coat's disease, parafoveal telangiectasis, hemi-retinal vein occlusion, papillophlebitis, central retinal artery occlusion, branch retinal artery occlusion, carotid artery disease (CAD), frosted branch angitis, sickle cell retinopathy, angioid streaks, familial exudative vitreoretinopathy, Eales disease, proliferative vitreal retinopathy, proliferative diabetic retinopathy, retinal disease associated with tumors, congenital hypertrophy of the RPE, posterior uveal melanoma, choroidal hemangioma, choroidal osteoma, choroidal metastasis, combined hamartoma of the retina and retinal pigmented epithelium, retinoblastoma, vasoproliferative tumors of the ocular fundus, retinal astrocytoma, intraocular lymphoid tumors, myopic retinal degeneration, acute retinal pigment epithelitis]] __macular degeneration, including non-exudative age related macular degeneration and exudative age related macular degeneration__.

34. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein said condition is __macular degeneration__.

36. (Currently amended) The method of claim 14 wherein said condition is __macular degeneration__.
